RETURN · PLAYABLE PROTOTYPE
The first camp
You wake beside a ruined shelter with nothing. A stranger waits nearby. Two days from now, this could be a home.
  1. Choose an intention. Gather food, repair the roof, or rest. Your character handles the journey.
  2. Ask people to stay. They have needs of their own. A meal or a promise can turn a stranger into an ally.
  3. Live with what follows. People remember care, stolen meals, and broken promises. Pause whenever you need to think.
Survive 12 shiftsRepair all 3 shelter sections · Keep 3 companions · Finish with 3 meals
Space pauses time. “Finish shift” advances immediately. This demo has no rewind; death ends the session.
